transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First off, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise, including gardening, after 1 week.  

If you mean heavier gardening or lifting, it’s best to avoid that for a month.  

Any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thanks for the information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.  

If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.  

Any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I've been feeling very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help.  

But if it’s severe, or you have pain and a red eye as well, that is not normal and we may need to check it further.  

Any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for the vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it.  

Any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I have no more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thank you!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` and `mild_case_advice` in the turn starting "Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lens." However, the `escalation_criteria` point was not conveyed at all. The agent did not mention any red-flag symptoms like significant pain or a red and painful eye that would require further assessment.
